data.content_ref: inline:Parameterize grounded semantics by a well-founded partial order on warrants. Each attack edge is effective only if the attacking warrant is not strictly dominated by a defending warrant that is accepted; otherwise it is ignored. For each fixed order, the resulting framework's grounded extension is deterministic and polynomial. Reinstatement remains derived because the order is static. This expands the semantics to priority-based conflicts without abandoning skepticism. Criticizable: the source of the order is unconstrained; if the order is not well-founded or inconsistent, the guarantees fail; this may be a preference-based argumentation variant rather than an extension of the original.
